focus_areas: Structural integrity of the suspension mechanism (wires to pole, wires to lights)
Clarity and distinctness of the lens colors (Red vs Amber)
Coherence of background vehicles (checking for melting/fusion)
Edge sharpness of the traffic light visors against the sky
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection points where the traffic lights hang from the wires. AI often struggles with thin linear structures like wires and small mechanical brackets. Also, scrutinize the background vehicles; if they appear as amorphous blobs rather than distinct cars/trucks, this is a strong indicator of generative failure in non-primary subjects.

The left signal displays red and amber lights, while the right signal displays a red light. Both are mounted on horizontal wires attached to a vertical wooden utility pole. Below the signals, there is a large truck or trailer and other indistinct vehicles. The image has a vintage, grainy aesthetic.

To confirm the object is correctly classified as a traffic light and not a similar street lamp or sign.
To check for edge bleeding between the black housing and the sky, and to ensure the visors are structurally connected to the main body.
To assess the overall coherence of the scene, particularly the blurry background vehicles which may hide generation artifacts.
